example.paragraph: $$\begin{array}{l} {{\int{x\ln xdx}} = {\int{udv = uv - {\int{vdu}}}}} \\ {\phantom{\int{x\ln xdx}} = {\frac{1}{2}x^{2}\ln x - {\int{\frac{1}{2}x^{2} \cdot \left( \frac{1}{x} \right)dx}}}} \\ {\phantom{\int{x\ln xdx}} = {\frac{1}{2}x^{2}\ln x - \frac{1}{2}{\int{xdx}}}} \\ {\phantom{\int{x\ln xdx}} = {\frac{1}{2}x^{2}\ln x - \frac{1}{4}x^{2} + C}} \\ {\phantom{\int{x\ln xdx}} = {\frac{1}{4}x^{2}\left( {2\ln x - 1} \right) + C}} \end{array}$$

Solution
example.paragraph: $$\begin{array}{l} {{\int{\frac{xe^{x}}{\left( {x + 1} \right)^{2}}dx}} = {\int{udv = uv - {\int{vdu}}}}} \\ {\phantom{\int{\frac{xe^{x}}{\left( {x + 1} \right)^{2}}dx}} = {xe^{x}\left( {- \frac{1}{x + 1}} \right) - {\int{\left( {- \frac{1}{x + 1}} \right)e^{x}\left( {x + 1} \right)dx}}}} \\ {\phantom{\int{\frac{xe^{x}}{\left( {x + 1} \right)^{2}}dx}} = {- \frac{xe^{x}}{x + 1} + {\int e^{x}}dx}} \\ {\phantom{\int{\frac{xe^{x}}{\left( {x + 1} \right)^{2}}dx}} = {- \frac{xe^{x}}{x + 1} + e^{x} + C}} \\ {\phantom{\int{\frac{xe^{x}}{\left( {x + 1} \right)^{2}}dx}} = {\frac{e^{x}}{x + 1} + C} {Combine first two terms.}} \end{array}$$
